resources.string: Hail reads fares, ETAs and the route from Uber, Ola and Rapido, and may tap inside them (to fill in your trip or close popups), only while a ride request you started is running. It reads nothing from any other app, stores nothing else, and stops instantly from its notification.

Before Hail can compare rides, it needs Android's Accessibility permission. Here is exactly what that means.

WHAT HAIL READS
• Only Uber, Ola and Rapido. Android blocks it from every other app.
• Only fares, ETAs and the route on the ride-selection screen.

WHEN
• Only while a ride request you started is running. You will always see a "Hail is working" notification with a Stop button.

WHAT IS STORED
• Fare, ETA, ride type and surge flag for each option. Never screenshots, screen text, your ride-app login, or anything about drivers.
• Your pickup and drop are used for the request and deleted with the session.

WHAT HAIL DOES
• Opens each ride app with your pickup and drop and reads the fares.
• Shows you every option. You pick one; Hail opens that app and YOU tap Book there. Hail never books for you.

YOUR LOGINS
• Hail uses the Uber, Ola and Rapido apps you are already logged in to. It never sees your password or OTP.

You can delete everything at any time from the Debug screen with Delete my data.
